name: 25314 · Charleston, WV
findings: ZIP 25314 (Charleston) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25314 (Charleston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 25314 (Charleston) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 25314 (Charleston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
